200.description: An array of MFA verifications for the user.

rpId.description: The relying party ID the WebAuthn credential was registered for. Only present for WebAuthn verifications. Absent for credentials registered before it was recorded and not used to sign in since; such a credential is bound to the domain that served the sign-in page at registration, which may not be the current custom domain.

credentialId.description: The base64url-encoded WebAuthn credential ID. Only present for WebAuthn verifications. The credential's `userHandle` is the UTF-8 bytes of the path `userId`.

publicKey.description: The base64url-encoded COSE public key of the WebAuthn credential. Only present for WebAuthn verifications.

counter.description: The last WebAuthn signature counter (`signCount`) seen for the credential. Only present for WebAuthn verifications.

transports.description: The transports the authenticator reported at registration. Only present for WebAuthn verifications.

get.description: Get a user's existing MFA verifications for a given user ID.

type.description: The type of MFA verification to create.

secret.description: The secret for the MFA verification, if not provided, a new secret will be generated.

type.description: The type of MFA verification to create.

codes.description: The backup codes for the MFA verification, if not provided, a new group of backup codes will be generated.

200.description: The MFA verification that was created.

post.summary: Create an MFA verification for a user
post.description: Create a new MFA verification for a given user ID.

204.description: The MFA verification was deleted successfully.

delete.summary: Delete an MFA verification for a user
delete.description: Delete an MFA verification for the user with the given verification ID. The verification ID must be associated with the given user ID.
